scripts.build:cloud: VITE_TARGET=cloud vite build --outDir dist-cloud && find dist-cloud -name '.DS_Store' -delete; node -e "const fs=require('fs');const w=fs.readFileSync('../cloud/wrangler.jsonc','utf8');if(!w.includes('single-page-application')){console.error('\u274c cloud/wrangler.jsonc \u7f3a SPA \u56de\u9000 \u2014\u2014 \u6df1\u94fe\u4f1a 404');process.exit(1)}if(fs.existsSync('dist-cloud/_redirects')){console.error('\u274c \u4ea7\u7269\u91cc\u6709 _redirects \u2014\u2014 Workers \u4f1a\u6821\u9a8c\u5b83\u5e76\u53ef\u80fd\u62d2\u7edd\u90e8\u7f72');process.exit(1)}if(!fs.existsSync('dist-cloud/index.html')){console.error('\u274c dist-cloud/index.html \u7f3a\u5931');process.exit(1)}console.log('\u2705 SPA \u56de\u9000\u7531 cloud/wrangler.jsonc \u63d0\u4f9b\uff0c\u4ea7\u7269\u5e72\u51c0')"
